name: netpulse-native
description: Net Pulse — Open Net Tools C++ path-latency engine as a CMake.js Node-API addon (in-process, no port)

scripts.install: node -e "console.log('[netpulse-native] npm install does not build the addon (no node-gyp). Run: npm run build:electron')"
scripts._note: This addon builds with CMake.js only (no node-gyp). `npm i` just fetches deps; run `npm run build:electron` to build for the installed Electron ABI.

author: Archisman Karmakar
